blueprint.title: The Heavy Box
blueprint.setting: A residential apartment building on a sunny afternoon.
blueprint.problem: Li Ming's mother has bought heavy groceries and cannot carry them up the stairs alone.
blueprint.incitingEvent: Li Ming sees his mother struggling with two large bags at the building entrance.

beats.what: Li Ming sees his mother holding heavy bags, looking tired.
beats.because: the story opens

beats.what: Li Ming asks his mother if she needs help carrying the bags.
beats.because: Li Ming sees his mother is struggling and identifies a need based on what he sees.

beats.what: Li Ming takes the bags from his mother and starts carrying them.
beats.because: His mother confirmed she needed assistance, prompting immediate action.

beats.what: Li Ming reflects on the importance of helping family members.
beats.because: The physical act of carrying reveals the value of his support.

beats.what: They put the bags down and Li Ming opens the door for her.
beats.because: They reached their destination, completing the task.

beats.what: Li Ming’s mother praises him, reinforcing their bond.
beats.because: The task is done, and they can rest and reflect.

blueprint.resolution: The groceries are safely inside, and Li Ming realizes that helping his mother strengthens their relationship.

targetPlan.why: Li Ming observes his mother and mentally categorizes her state to justify his intervention, using 'woman' to refer to her in a descriptive, observant way before speaking.
targetPlan.speaker: Narrator/Li Ming's thought
targetPlan.intent: To describe the person in distress objectively.

targetPlan.why: Li Ming evaluates the situation and identifies a lack of resources (strength) that must be filled by his presence.
targetPlan.speaker: Li Ming
targetPlan.intent: To confirm the problem exists before acting.

targetPlan.why: Li Ming takes physical action, and the verb 'help' accurately describes the transfer of burden.
targetPlan.speaker: Narrator
targetPlan.refersTo: The action of carrying the bags
targetPlan.intent: To describe the core action of the story.
targetPlan.usageSketch: 我帮助妈妈拿重的东西。

targetPlan.why: Li Ming reflects internally on why he helped, connecting the action to the abstract concept of their bond.
targetPlan.speaker: Li Ming's thought
targetPlan.refersTo: The bond between Li Ming and his mother
targetPlan.intent: To express the emotional significance of the action.

targetPlan.why: Li Ming sees himself in the role of a protector/helper, contrasting his role with his mother's, using 'man' to define his capacity to carry heavy items.
targetPlan.speaker: Narrator/Li Ming's thought
targetPlan.intent: To define his role in this specific interaction.
targetPlan.usageSketch: 我是男人，我可以拿重物。

blueprint.title: The Neighbor's Heavy Box
blueprint.problem: Xiao Hong cannot carry a heavy box up the stairs alone and needs help to get inside.
blueprint.incitingEvent: Li Ming sees Xiao Hong struggling with a large box at the bottom of the stairwell.

beats.what: Li Ming meets Xiao Hong, who is holding a very heavy box.
beats.because: the story opens
beats.arrivedHow: Li Ming is going home after work.

beats.what: Li Ming asks if Xiao Hong needs help because the box looks difficult to carry.
beats.because: Li Ming sees Xiao Hong struggling.

beats.what: They talk while Li Ming carries the box up. Li Ming asks why she is carrying it alone.
beats.because: They are now moving together with the box.
beats.arrivedHow: They start walking up the stairs together.

beats.what: Xiao Hong explains her father is at work. She mentions that if he were there, he would help.
beats.because: Li Ming asked about her father.

beats.what: They arrive at the door. Xiao Hong thanks Li Ming for his help.
beats.because: They reached the top of the stairs.
beats.arrivedHow: They walked the rest of the way to the door.

beats.what: They say goodbye. Li Ming feels happy to help a neighbor.
beats.because: The task is finished.

blueprint.resolution: Li Ming successfully helps Xiao Hong carry the box upstairs, resolving the physical difficulty and strengthening their neighborly bond.

targetPlan.why: To identify Xiao Hong as a female character in the narrative description, distinguishing her from other potential helpers.
targetPlan.speaker: Narrator
targetPlan.intent: To introduce the character visually and grammatically.

targetPlan.why: To describe the physical state of the box, which is the core reason help is needed.
targetPlan.speaker: Li Ming (thought) / Narrator
targetPlan.intent: To explain why Xiao Hong is struggling.

targetPlan.why: To ask if assistance is requested, initiating the cooperative action.
targetPlan.speaker: Li Ming
targetPlan.intent: To offer help politely.

targetPlan.why: To name the specific action Li Ming is offering to perform.
targetPlan.speaker: Li Ming
targetPlan.intent: To clarify the offer.

targetPlan.why: To contrast Xiao Hong's situation (carrying alone) with what she can't do (ask her father/male relative).
targetPlan.speaker: Li Ming
targetPlan.intent: To ask why the male family member isn't helping.

targetPlan.why: To express a hypothetical situation about her father being present, explaining the current lack of help.
targetPlan.speaker: Xiao Hong
targetPlan.intent: To explain the context of her struggle.
targetPlan.usageSketch: 如果爸爸在家，他就帮我了。

targetPlan.why: To comment on the social connection between neighbors and friends, reinforcing the theme.
targetPlan.speaker: Xiao Hong
targetPlan.intent: To express gratitude based on their social bond.

blueprint.title: The Neighbor's Heavy Box
blueprint.setting: Sunday afternoon in a typical Chinese residential building.
blueprint.problem: Li Ming needs to move a heavy box but cannot open the door because his hands are full, and he sees a neighbor who might help.
blueprint.incitingEvent: Li Ming arrives with a heavy box and realizes he cannot reach the door handle with his hands occupied.

beats.where: The entrance hall of the apartment building
beats.what: Li Ming arrives carrying a very heavy box. He tries to open the door but his hands are full.
beats.because: the story opens

beats.what: Xiao Hong gets off the elevator and sees Li Ming struggling with the door.
beats.because: the elevator opens and Xiao Hong steps out

beats.what: Li Ming talks to Xiao Hong. He explains that he needs someone to hold the door open because his hands are holding the box.
beats.because: Xiao Hong is present and sees the problem

beats.what: Xiao Hong agrees without hesitation. She says that if he has a problem, she will help him.
beats.because: Li Ming asked for help

beats.what: Li Ming puts the box down. He thanks Xiao Hong and invites her to sit down. They walk into the room together.
beats.because: The door is open and Xiao Hong is assisting

beats.what: They sit and drink water. Li Ming reflects on how good it is to have neighbors. He describes Xiao Hong as a helpful woman and himself as a man who needs friends.
beats.because: The crisis is over and they are relaxing

blueprint.resolution: The box is safely inside, and Li Ming and Xiao Hong establish a friendly rapport, resolving the physical problem and social isolation.

targetPlan.why: Li Ming is explaining his physical limitation. He needs to communicate that he lacks the ability to open the door *and* hold the box simultaneously.
targetPlan.speaker: 李明
targetPlan.refersTo: The action of opening the door while holding the box
targetPlan.intent: To request assistance based on physical necessity
targetPlan.usageSketch: 我现在需要人帮我开门。

targetPlan.why: Xiao Hong is responding to the request. She wants to affirm that providing aid is something she is willing to do.
targetPlan.speaker: 小红
targetPlan.refersTo: The act of opening the door for Li Ming
targetPlan.intent: To offer assistance willingly

targetPlan.why: Xiao Hong is setting a conditional context for her help, implying that for future problems or this current one, the condition of needing help triggers her aid.
targetPlan.speaker: 小红
targetPlan.intent: To express conditional readiness to help
targetPlan.usageSketch: 如果你有问题，我会帮助你的。

targetPlan.why: Li Ming is reflecting on Xiao Hong's character. He uses the word to categorize her gender while praising her behavior, contrasting it with his own internal thoughts about gender roles or simply describing her.
targetPlan.speaker: 李明
targetPlan.intent: To describe Xiao Hong's gender and positive traits

targetPlan.why: Li Ming reflects on himself. He feels slightly embarrassed or humbled that he needed help, contrasting his identity as a male with the act of receiving help.
targetPlan.speaker: 李明
targetPlan.intent: To reflect on his own gender identity in the context of vulnerability
targetPlan.usageSketch: 作为一个男人，我不能总是麻烦别人。

targetPlan.why: Li Ming concludes the interaction by valuing the social bond formed. He wants to express that the connection between them is important.
targetPlan.speaker: 李明
targetPlan.refersTo: The friendship/neighborly bond between Li Ming and Xiao Hong
targetPlan.intent: To affirm the value of their social connection

blueprint.title: Moving House
blueprint.setting: A Saturday afternoon in the neighborhood of the characters' apartments.
blueprint.problem: Xiao Ming cannot finish moving his furniture alone and needs physical assistance.
blueprint.incitingEvent: Xiao Ming tries to lift a heavy box and realizes he cannot do it alone.

beats.what: Xiao Ming is moving boxes. He tries to lift a big box but cannot lift it.
beats.because: the story opens

beats.what: Xiao Ming thinks about asking his neighbor. He worries about disturbing others.
beats.because: He cannot lift the box, so he considers seeking help.

beats.what: Xiao Ming knocks on Xiao Hong's door. Xiao Hong opens it.
beats.because: Xiao Ming decides he needs help more than he fears being a bother.
beats.arrivedHow: Xiao Ming walks next door and knocks.

beats.what: Xiao Ming asks for help. Xiao Hong agrees because they are good friends.
beats.because: Xiao Ming asked, so Xiao Hong can respond.

beats.what: They move the boxes together. Xiao Hong talks about being helpful to others.
beats.because: They agreed to help, so they perform the action.

beats.what: The move is done. Xiao Ming treats Xiao Hong to dinner. They talk about their roles.
beats.because: The work is finished, so they celebrate and reflect.

blueprint.resolution: The boxes are moved. Xiao Ming and Xiao Hong eat together, strengthening their neighborhood bond.

targetPlan.why: Xiao Ming realizes he lacks the strength to move the box alone and identifies his lack.
targetPlan.speaker: Xiao Ming (thought)
targetPlan.intent: To acknowledge his inability to do it alone
targetPlan.usageSketch: 我一个人搬不动，我需要帮助。

targetPlan.why: Xiao Ming makes a specific request for Xiao Hong's physical labor.
targetPlan.speaker: Xiao Ming
targetPlan.refersTo: The act of moving the boxes
targetPlan.intent: To politely ask for a favor

targetPlan.why: Xiao Hong explains the principle of cooperation.
targetPlan.speaker: Xiao Hong
targetPlan.intent: To justify her help as a moral duty
targetPlan.usageSketch: 朋友之间，我们必须互相帮助。

targetPlan.why: Xiao Hong sets a condition for future interaction.
targetPlan.speaker: Xiao Hong
targetPlan.intent: To encourage Xiao Ming to ask in the future

targetPlan.why: Xiao Hong adds an additional reason for helping.
targetPlan.speaker: Xiao Hong
targetPlan.intent: To show she is not just doing it out of duty, but also likes it

targetPlan.why: Xiao Hong comments on Xiao Ming's capability despite needing help.
targetPlan.speaker: Xiao Hong
targetPlan.intent: To compliment him on his effort while acknowledging gender roles lightly

targetPlan.why: Xiao Hong refers to herself or her role in the neighborhood.
targetPlan.speaker: Xiao Hong
targetPlan.intent: To identify herself in the context of the neighborhood community

targetPlan.why: They reflect on the result of the interaction.
targetPlan.speaker: Narrator or Xiao Ming
targetPlan.intent: To state that the interaction improved their connection
